summary.text: Jim Nash is a Republican member of the Minnesota House of Representatives for District 48A, in office since 2015, and is running for re-election on November 3, 2026, against Democrat Joe Brothers.

paragraphs.text: Jim Nash has served in the Minnesota House since 2015, according to Ballotpedia.
He defeated Nathan Kells in the November 8, 2022, and November 5, 2024, general elections for District 48A; he previously won election in District 47A.

For 2025-2026 he is co-chair of the State Government Finance and Policy Committee and serves on the House Housing Finance and Policy, Rules and Legislative Administration, and Ways and Means committees.
